title: Convert index.html to Next.js Components with TypeScript
description: Comprehensive task list to convert an existing static HTML file (index.html) into a dynamic Next.js application using TypeScript, breaking down the HTML into reusable React components, integrating styles, and ensuring functionality.

tasks.title: Initialize Next.js Project
tasks.description: Create a new Next.js project with TypeScript support. This establishes the foundational environment for component conversion.

tasks.title: Analyze Original HTML Structure
tasks.description: Thoroughly review `index.html` to understand its DOM structure, identify potential reusable components, recognize external assets (CSS, JS, images, fonts), and note any inline styles or scripts. Plan component hierarchy.

tasks.title: Migrate Static Assets (Images, Fonts)
tasks.description: Copy all images, fonts, and other non-code static assets from the original project structure into the Next.js `public` directory. Update paths in the HTML/CSS if necessary for temporary viewing.

tasks.title: Determine Styling Strategy and Migrate Global CSS
tasks.description: Decide on the CSS strategy (e.g., CSS Modules, Tailwind CSS, global CSS, styled-components). Migrate any global CSS files by moving them into the `styles` directory and importing them into `_app.tsx`.

tasks.title: Create Base Layout Component
tasks.description: Develop a `Layout` (or similar) TypeScript React component in `components/layout/Layout.tsx` that includes common elements like `Head` for meta tags, global styling imports, and potentially a wrapper for the page content. This component will serve as a common wrapper for all pages.

tasks.title: Extract and Create Header Component
tasks.description: Identify the header section in `index.html`. Create a new TypeScript React component (e.g., `components/Header.tsx`). Migrate the corresponding HTML structure and apply initial styling (using chosen strategy).

tasks.title: Extract and Create Footer Component
tasks.description: Identify the footer section in `index.html`. Create a new TypeScript React component (e.g., `components/Footer.tsx`). Migrate the corresponding HTML structure and apply initial styling.

tasks.title: Extract and Create Main Content Sections as Components
tasks.description: Break down the main content of `index.html` into logical, reusable sections (e.g., 'Hero', 'About Us', 'Services', 'Contact'). Create individual TypeScript React components for each section (e.g., `components/sections/Hero.tsx`, `components/sections/About.tsx`). Migrate HTML and initial styling.

tasks.title: Create `index.tsx` Page and Assemble Components
tasks.description: Create the main `pages/index.tsx` file. Import the `Layout`, `Header`, `Footer`, and all main section components. Assemble them within `index.tsx` to replicate the original `index.html` structure. Ensure correct component nesting and props passing.

tasks.title: Integrate Component-Specific CSS
tasks.description: For each created component, migrate its relevant CSS (either from external files or inline styles) into dedicated CSS Modules (e.g., `Header.module.css`) or apply Tailwind CSS classes. Ensure correct class name application in JSX.

tasks.title: Convert Inline/External JavaScript to React Logic
tasks.description: Identify any inline `<script>` tags or external `.js` files in the original `index.html`. Convert their functionality into React hooks (`useState`, `useEffect`) or utility functions within the relevant components. Address DOM manipulation with React's paradigm.

tasks.title: Initial Visual and Functional Testing
tasks.description: Run `npm run dev` and open the Next.js application in a browser. Visually compare the rendered page with the original `index.html`. Test basic interactive elements (e.g., navigation, buttons, forms). Log any discrepancies or errors.

tasks.title: Debug Layout and Styling Issues
tasks.description: Address any visual discrepancies identified during initial testing. This includes fixing broken layouts, incorrect sizing, font issues, and color mismatches. Utilize browser developer tools for debugging CSS.

tasks.title: Refactor Components and Code Cleanup
tasks.description: Review all created components and pages for code quality. Refactor redundant code, ensure proper TypeScript types, add comments where necessary, and remove any unused imports or placeholder content. Optimize image loading if needed.

tasks.title: Final Verification and Cross-Browser Check
tasks.description: Perform a final comprehensive check of the converted Next.js application. Verify all features work as expected and the styling is consistent across major browsers (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge). Confirm responsiveness if applicable.

tasks.title: Read and analyze HTML file
tasks.description: Read the HTML file and extract structure, scripts, and styles

tasks.title: Merge HTML with local resources
tasks.description: Inline all CSS and JavaScript files into the HTML

tasks.title: Apply basic transformations
tasks.description: Convert HTML attributes to JSX format (class -> className, etc.)

tasks.title: Analyze component structure
tasks.description: Use AI to identify reusable components in the HTML

tasks.title: Convert to Next.js components
tasks.description: Transform HTML sections into TypeScript React components

tasks.title: Create main page
tasks.description: Generate the main page.tsx that imports and uses all components

tasks.title: Review and test output
tasks.description: Review the generated code for quality and test for errors

goals: Fully convert index.html into a functional Next.js application
Break down monolithic HTML into reusable, maintainable React/TypeScript components
Integrate all original styling and JavaScript functionality
Ensure visual fidelity and functional equivalence with the original HTML
